turns.question: For customers whose first order was placed in October 2026, what was the median number of days between their signup date and that first order?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median number of days from signup to first order, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metric is Signup-to-first-order rate (the share of customers who placed their first order within 30 days of signing up), which does not answer the median question, so no figure was computed and no freshness statement was returned.
